function u1.KillTaper(p54: number) -- Line: 532
    local v55 = 1 - math.max(0, p54 - 6) * 0.04;

    return math.clamp(v55, 0.6, 1);
end;

function u1.KillShare(p56: number, p57: number) -- Line: 535
    -- upvalues: u1 (copy)
    local v58 = p57 - p56;
    local v59;

    if v58 >= 0 then
        v59 = 1.35 ^ v58;
    else
        v59 = 0.6 ^ (-v58);
    end;

    local v60 = v59 * 0.25 * u1.KillTaper(p56);

    return math.clamp(v60, 0.004, 0.6);
end;

function u1.GapMult(p61: number, p62: number) -- Line: 541
    local v63 = p61 - p62;

    return v63 >= 5 and 0.05 or (v63 >= 3 and 0.3 or 1);
end;

function u1.KillBounty(p64: number, p65: number, p66: number) -- Line: 552
    -- upvalues: u1 (copy)
    return u1.Need(p66) * u1.KillShare(p66, p64);
end;

function u1.KillDna(p67: number, p68: number) -- Line: 555
    -- upvalues: u1 (copy)
    local v69 = (p67 * 2 + 3) * u1.GapMult(p68, p67) + 0.5;

    return math.floor(v69);
end;

function u1.MoveFor(p75) -- Line: 759
    -- upvalues: u1 (copy)
    local v76 = tonumber(p75) or 0;
    local math_floor_ret = math.floor(v76);
    local v77 = u1.Species[math_floor_ret];

    if not v77 then
        return nil;
    end;

    local v78 = u1.MoveOf[v77.key];

    if not (v78 or (u1.MoveLastStage >= math_floor_ret or u1.MoveLastStage <= 0)) then
        v78 = u1.MoveOf[u1.Species[u1.MoveLastStage].key];
    end;

    return v78;
end;

function u1.MoveNum(p79: string, p80: number?) -- Line: 772
    -- upvalues: u1 (copy)
    local v81 = u1.Moves[p79];
    local v82 = tonumber(p80) or 4;
    local math_max_ret = math.max(1, v82);

    return p79 == "Roll" and {
        dist = v81.Distance * math_max_ret + v81.DistanceAdd,
        secs = v81.Seconds
    } or (p79 == "Pounce" and {
        range = v81.Range * math_max_ret + v81.RangeAdd,
        min = v81.Min,
        secs = v81.Seconds,
        hop = v81.Hop * math_max_ret,
        radius = v81.Radius * math_max_ret + v81.RadiusAdd
    } or (p79 == "Charge" and {
        dist = v81.Distance * math_max_ret + v81.DistanceAdd,
        secs = v81.Seconds,
        width = v81.Width * math_max_ret + v81.WidthAdd
    } or (p79 == "Snap" and {
        back = v81.Back * math_max_ret + v81.BackAdd,
        secs = v81.Seconds,
        hop = v81.Hop * math_max_ret
    } or (p79 == "Swarm" and {
        radius = v81.Radius * math_max_ret + v81.RadiusAdd,
        secs = v81.Seconds,
        length = math.max(1.6, v81.Length * math_max_ret)
    } or {
        secs = not (v81 and v81.Seconds) and 0 or v81.Seconds
    }))));
end;

function u1.StarPerkFx(p91: string, p92: number?) -- Line: 1026
    -- upvalues: u1 (copy)
    local v93 = {};
    local v94 = u1.StarPerks[p91];

    if type(v94) ~= "table" then
        return v93;
    end;

    local v95 = tonumber(p92) or 1;
    local math_floor_ret = math.floor(v95);
    local math_clamp_ret = math.clamp(math_floor_ret, 1, u1.MaxStars);

    for i = 1, math.min(#v94, math_clamp_ret - 1) do
        local _ = i;

        for i2, v in v94[i] do
            if type(v) == "number" then
                v93[i2] = (v93[i2] or 0) + v;
            end;
        end;
    end;

    return v93;
end;

function u1.PerkPct(p100: number) -- Line: 1053
    local v101 = math.abs(p100) * 100;

    if v101 < 1 then
        return string.format("%.1f", v101) .. "%";
    end;

    local math_floor_ret = math.floor(v101 + 0.5);

    return tostring(math_floor_ret) .. "%";
end;

function u1.PowerWord(p102: string) -- Line: 1061
    -- upvalues: u1 (copy), u98 (copy), u99 (copy)
    local v103 = u1.MutationByKey[p102];

    if not v103 then
        return "power";
    end;

    if v103.ability and u98[v103.ability] then
        return u98[v103.ability];
    end;

    for _, v in u99 do
        if type(v103.fx) == "table" and v103.fx[v] == true then
            return u98[v];
        end;
    end;

    return "power";
end;

function u1.StarPerkText(p104: string, p105: number) -- Line: 1077
    -- upvalues: u1 (copy), u96 (copy), u97 (copy)
    local v106 = u1.StarPerks[p104];

    if v106 then
        v106 = v106[p105];
    end;

    if type(v106) ~= "table" then
        return "";
    end;

    if type(v106.t) == "string" then
        return v106.t;
    end;

    local v107 = {};

    for _, v in u96 do
        local v108 = v106[v];

        if type(v108) == "number" and v108 ~= 0 then
            local v109;

            if v == "power" then
                v109 = u1.PowerWord(p104);
            else
                v109 = u97[v];
            end;

            local v110 = (v108 < 0 and "-" or "+") .. u1.PerkPct(v108) .. " " .. v109;
            table.insert(v107, v110);
        end;
    end;

    return table.concat(v107, ", ");
end;

function u1.RarityWeights(p111: number) -- Line: 1097
    -- upvalues: u1 (copy)
    local v112 = {};

    for i, v in u1.Rarities do
        local v113;

        if v.secret then
            v113 = v.weight * p111 ^ 0.75;
        elseif i >= 3 then
            v113 = v.weight * p111;
        else
            v113 = v.weight;
        end;

        v112[i] = v113;
    end;

    return v112;
end;

end;

function u1.PetRarity(p171: string, p172: number, p173: number?) -- Line: 1583
    -- upvalues: u1 (copy)

    if not v174 then
        return nil;
    end;

    local order = (u1.RarityByKey[u1.Pets.LuckFrom] or {
        order = 4
    }).order;
    local v175 = tonumber(p173) or 1;
    local math_clamp_ret = math.clamp(v175, 1, u1.Pets.LuckCap);
    local v176 = {};
    local v177 = 0;

        local v178 = v174.odds[v.key] or 0;

        if v178 > 0 and order <= v.order then

        end;

        v176[v.key] = v178;
        v177 = v177 + v178;
    end;

    local v179 = math.clamp(p172, 0, 0.999999) * v177;

    for _, v in u1.Rarities do
        v179 = v179 - v176[v.key];

        if v179 < 0 and v176[v.key] > 0 then
            return v.key;
        end;
    end;

    for i = #u1.Rarities, 1, -1 do
        if v176[u1.Rarities[i].key] > 0 then
            return u1.Rarities[i].key;
        end;

    end;

    return nil;
end;

function u1.LimitedPowerMult(p216) -- Line: 1978
    -- upvalues: u1 (copy)
    local v217 = 1;

    if type(p216) == "table" then
        for _, v in u1.LimitedPacks do
            if p216[v.key] ~= nil then
                v217 = v217 * (v.power or 1);
            end;
        end;
    end;

    return v217;
end;

function u1.LimitedBest(p218) -- Line: 1990
    -- upvalues: u1 (copy)
    local v219 = nil;
    local v220 = 0;

    if type(p218) == "table" then
        for _, v in u1.LimitedPacks do
            if p218[v.key] ~= nil then
                local v221 = tonumber(p218[v.key]) or 0;
                local math_floor_ret = math.floor(v221);
                v220 = math.max(0, math_floor_ret);
                v219 = v;
            end;
        end;
    end;

    return v219, v220;
end;

function u1.NearestEggHint(p256: vector?, p257: any) -- Line: 2461

            local v260;

            if typeof(p256) == "Vector3" then
                v260 = (v - p256).Magnitude;
            else
                v260 = i;
            end;

                v259 = i;

end;

local function rigidify(p43) -- Line: 481

    end;

local function stepDevour(p49: any, p50: number) -- Line: 523
    -- upvalues: rigidify (copy), Common (copy), gulp (copy), u2 (copy), Workspace (copy)

    local v61 = {};

    for _, v in p49.rigid do
        local part = v.part;

        if part.Parent then

    end;

    return false;
end;

local function paintable(p11: userdata) -- Line: 354
    if p11.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" or p11.Transparency >= 0.95 then
        return false;
    end;

    if p11:GetAttribute("Baked") == true or (p11:GetAttribute("Glow") == true or p11:GetAttribute("AntLook") == true) then
        return false;
    end;

    return p11.Material ~= Enum.Material.Neon and (p11.Material ~= Enum.Material.Glass and p11.Name:sub(1, 4) ~= "Wing");
end;

    for _, descendant in p26:GetDescendants() do

                            descendant.Material = p27.accentMaterial;
                            descendant.Reflectance = 0;

                            if v28 then
                                table.insert(v28, descendant);
                            end;
                        elseif p27.mainMaterial and u16[descendant.Name] then
                            descendant.Material = p27.mainMaterial;
                            descendant.Reflectance = 0;

                            if v29 then
                                table.insert(v29, descendant);
                            end;
                        end;
                    elseif p27.mainMaterial and u16[descendant.Name] then
                        descendant.Material = p27.mainMaterial;
                        descendant.Reflectance = 0;

                        if v29 then
                            table.insert(v29, descendant);
                        end;

local function makeEmitter(p35: any, p36: number, p37) -- Line: 656
    -- upvalues: Assets (copy), u7 (copy), rainbowSeq (copy), seq (copy)
    local ParticleEmitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter");
    ParticleEmitter.Name = "AntLookFx";
    local fallback = p35.fallback;
    local v38 = Assets.Textures[p35.tex];
    local v39;

    if type(v38) == "number" and v38 ~= 0 then
        v39 = "rbxassetid://" .. v38;
    else
        v39 = u7[fallback or "Glow"] or u7.Glow;
    end;

    ParticleEmitter.Texture = v39;

    if p35.rainbow then
        ParticleEmitter.Color = rainbowSeq();
    elseif p37 then
        ParticleEmitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(p37);
    elseif #p35.colors > 1 then
        ParticleEmitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(p35.colors[1], p35.colors[2]);
    else
        ParticleEmitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(p35.colors[1]);
    end;

    ParticleEmitter.LightEmission = p35.light or 0.5;
    ParticleEmitter.LightInfluence = 0;
    ParticleEmitter.Size = seq(p35.size[1], p35.size[2], p36);
    local v40 = p35.trans or 0.1;
    ParticleEmitter.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.15, v40),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.7, v40 + 0.15),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)
    });
    ParticleEmitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(p35.life[1], p35.life[2]);
    ParticleEmitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(p35.speed[1] * p36, p35.speed[2] * p36);
    ParticleEmitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(p35.spread or 180, p35.spread or 180);
    ParticleEmitter.Acceleration = (p35.accel or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)) * p36;
    ParticleEmitter.Drag = 1;

    if p35.rot then
        ParticleEmitter.Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360);
        ParticleEmitter.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-90, 90);
    end;

    ParticleEmitter.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top;
    ParticleEmitter.Rate = 0;
    ParticleEmitter.Enabled = true;

    return ParticleEmitter;
end;

local function paintBody(p42: any, p43: userdata, p44: any) -- Line: 414

    local v46 = nil;

        local v47 = u1[i];

        if v47 and (not v45 or v47.order < v45.order) then
            v46 = i;
            v45 = v47;
        end;
    end;

    p42.rainbow = nil;
    p42.nebula = nil;
    p42.star = nil;
    p42.aurora = nil;

    if v45 then
        local v48 = {};

        for _, descendant in p43:GetDescendants() do
            if descendant:IsA("BasePart") and paintable(descendant) then
                if not p42.orig[descendant] then
                    p42.orig[descendant] = {
                        c = descendant.Color,
                        m = descendant.Material,
                        r = descendant.Reflectance,
                        t = descendant.Transparency
                    };
                end;

                local v49 = p42.orig[descendant];
                local v50 = p42.bred[descendant] or v49.c;

                if v45.rainbow then
                    table.insert(v48, descendant);
                elseif v45.darken then
                    descendant.Color = v50:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), v45.darken);
                else
                    local _, _, v51 = v50:ToHSV();
                    local v52, v53, v54 = (v45.parts and v45.parts[descendant.Name] or v45.color):ToHSV();

                    if v45.nebula or (v45.star or v45.aurora) then
                        table.insert(v48, descendant);
                    end;
                end;

                if v45.material then
                    descendant.Material = v45.material;
                end;

                if v45.reflect then
                    descendant.Reflectance = math.max(v49.r, v45.reflect);
                end;

                if v45.glowParts and v45.glowParts[descendant.Name] then
                    descendant.Color = v45.glowParts[descendant.Name];
                    descendant.Material = Enum.Material.Neon;
                end;
            end;
        end;

        if v45.rainbow then
            p42.rainbow = v48;
        elseif v45.nebula then
            p42.nebula = v48;
        elseif v45.star then
            p42.star = v48;
        elseif v45.aurora then

                    p42.orig[v55] = {
                        c = v55.Color,
                        m = v55.Material,
                        r = v55.Reflectance,
                        t = v55.Transparency
                    };

                v55.Reflectance = 0.12;
            end;
        end;
    end;

    if p44.Acid and (not v45 or v45.order > u1.Frost.order) then

        if Abdomen and (Abdomen:IsA("BasePart") and paintable(Abdomen)) then
            if not p42.orig[Abdomen] then
                p42.orig[Abdomen] = {

                    m = Abdomen.Material,
                    r = Abdomen.Reflectance,

            end;

            Abdomen.Color = (p42.bred[Abdomen] or p42.orig[Abdomen].c):Lerp(Color3_fromRGB(120, 230, 60), 0.45);
        end;
    end;

local function onEnded(p254: userdata) -- Line: 1147
    -- upvalues: u3 (copy), Enum_KeyCode (copy), Pilot (copy), UserInputService (copy)
    local UserInputType = p254.UserInputType;

    elseif string.sub(UserInputType.Name, 1, 7) == "Gamepad" then

                u3.hold.pad = false;
            end;
        elseif KeyCode == Enum_KeyCode.ButtonB then
            u3.down.pad = false;
            Pilot.flyDown = u3.down.key or (u3.down.pad or u3.down.signal);
        end;
    end;

local function step(p99: number) -- Line: 412
    -- upvalues: u3 (copy), u2 (copy), scan (copy), Common (copy), killPoison (copy), Registry (copy), stepLeaf (copy), stepSwarm (copy), Workspace (copy)
    local math_min_ret = math.min(p99, 0.1);
    local os_clock_ret = os.clock();

    if u3.scanAt <= os_clock_ret then
        u3.scanAt = os_clock_ret + u2.SCAN;
        scan();
    end;

    table.clear(u3.parts);
    table.clear(u3.cfs);

    for i, v in u3.recs do
        local v100 = Common.Root(i);

        if v100 and i.Parent then
            if v.leaf then
                stepLeaf(v, v100, os_clock_ret);
            end;

            if v.swarm then
                stepSwarm(i, v.swarm, v100, math_min_ret, os_clock_ret);
            end;
        else
            local leaf = v.leaf;

            if leaf then
                v.leaf = nil;

                if type(leaf.stop) == "function" then
                    pcall(leaf.stop);
                end;

                leaf.part:Destroy();
            end;

            killPoison(v);
            local swarm = v.swarm;
            local v101;

            if swarm then
                v.swarm = nil;
                u3.swarms = math.max(0, u3.swarms - 1);
                v101 = i;

                for _, v2 in swarm.minis do
                    local Anim = Registry.Anim;

                    if Anim and Anim.Untrack then
                        pcall(Anim.Untrack, v2.model);
                    end;

                    v2.model:Destroy();
                end;
            else
                v101 = i;
            end;

            u3.recs[v101] = nil;
        end;
    end;

    if #u3.parts > 0 then
        Workspace:BulkMoveTo(u3.parts, u3.cfs, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged);
    end;
end;

            end;
